name: Pizzeria Sterndl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Sterndl in Tirol**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Sterndl** in the heart of **Tirol**—where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the Alps. Just a short stroll from **Innsbruck**’s bustling center, this cozy spot serves up handmade pizzas with fresh, local ingredients. Try their signature **Tiroler Spezialität**—a crispy base topped with regional cheeses, crispy bacon, and a touch of Alpine herbs.

After your meal, warm up with a **Kaiserschmarrn** or a frothy **Apfelstrudel**, paired with a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner** or a smooth **Tiroler Bier**. The rustic wooden interior and crackling fireplace make it the perfect escape after a day of exploring **Tirol**’s stunning landscapes—whether you’re skiing in the **Karwendel** or hiking through the **Zillertal**.

Open daily for lunch and dinner, **Pizzeria Sterndl** is your go-to for a taste of Italy with a **Tiroler** twist. **Buon appetito!**
